external_entities.name: Customer
external_entities.description: A person who browses and places orders through the mobile app and receives faxed confirmations.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

external_entities.name: Marketing
external_entities.description: The Sokify marketing function that maintains the catalogue in a spreadsheet.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: Sokify's mobile application used by customers to browse and order socks.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: web API
processes.description: The API used by the mobile app to handle customer data and orders, and by spreadsheet macros to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication.

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: Sokify's stock and inventory system that receives orders, writes delivery addresses, and sends dispatch notes.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS, our stock and inventory system

processes.name: fax gateway
processes.description: A gateway that sends dispatch confirmations by fax to the number stored against an order.
processes.source_excerpt: the fax gateway, which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
processes.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

processes.name: spreadsheet macros
processes.description: Macros in the marketing spreadsheet that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_stores.name: user database
data_stores.description: The database containing customer names, addresses, and the cards they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the user database is encrypted.

data_stores.name: flat file
data_stores.description: A file kept alongside SIMS containing delivery addresses only.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the flat file is encrypted.

data_stores.name: spreadsheet
data_stores.description: The marketing catalogue containing prices and product copy, stored on a marketing laptop in the office.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

assumptions.assumption: The mobile app runs on a customer-controlled device.
assumptions.basis: Customers use the mobile app, and the customer device is therefore treated as a separate party-controlled zone.
Sokify sells online through a mobile app that communicates with the web API.
It contains customer names, addresses, and payment card information.
It contains commercially sensitive catalogue prices and product copy.
